QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_53

question.text: Vaibhav Growth AIF has committed capital of INR 60 crore, hurdle rate 10% p.a., fund tenure 3 years. Cumulative hurdle amount (compounded) at end of Year 3 (rounded):

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Compounded hurdle amount = 60 × [(1.10)^3 − 1] = 60 × [1.331 − 1] = 60 × 0.331 = INR 19.86 crore. **The Trap:** Option A is simple-interest computation (10% × 3 × 60). Option C is off. Option D is 1-year hurdle only. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-A/B tests compounded hurdle; XIX-C extends to waterfall. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Default to compounded hurdle in PPM unless LPs specifically push for simple interest — compounded aligns with how LP opportunity cost actually works. Document the compounding frequency (annually common in India).
